dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare Advantage organizations, participating health care providers, and Medicare beneficiaries subject to prior authorization.
dimensions.evidence: an MA plan that imposes a prior authorization requirement with respect to an item or service

dimensions.assessment: Imposes mandatory clinical review, independent medical judgment attestations, direct communication opportunities, and record retention rules for prior authorization denials.
dimensions.evidence: may not deny a request for prior authorization with respect to such item or service based on the output of artificial intelligence, unless the following requirements are met

dimensions.assessment: Requires reporting to the Secretary and grants audit authority, but does not specify direct federal spending amounts.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may audit and inspect any use of artificial intelligence by such plan

dimensions.assessment: Amends title XVIII of the Social Security Act to add regulatory compliance standards for Medicare Advantage plans.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1852 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395w-22) is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently to plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2027, with ongoing 90-day reporting intervals and 10-year record retention mandates.
dimensions.evidence: plan years beginning on or after January 1, 2027

importance_detail.rationale: H.R. 9734 establishes strict requirements for Medicare Advantage organizations using artificial intelligence in prior authorization denials, requiring physician review, attestations, disclosures, and periodic reporting.
